# CLAIMs with `line` `record-as-apparatus`

*Lines of inquiry — A named line of the record's own argument, so that a line can be set aside as a whole and what depends on it can be found. Retracting a line is a status change on its members, never a deletion (ADR-032).*

**The record as its own apparatus** — what an apparatus of record-keeping makes determinate and how its grammar is fixed and revised through use — the record itself as the case; inquiry as specification in general is learning-and-inquiry's; split from nucleating-argument (ADR-082).

| [CLAIM-928](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-928.md) | In a simulation of a collective that improves its own improver, a later improver does better than an earlier one from the same starting state at the same budget through procedures that consult its record, not through the record alone; a test of the improver's products does not see it shed its own checks; and when those checks are damaged, a record of what past moves cost keeps verification that an improver blind to it loses | From the run of [LEAD-140](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-140.md) ([CASE-348](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-348.md)), a reduced simulation of [CASE-255](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-255.md) on [CASE-332](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-332.md)'s organization. | [CLAIM-942](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-942.md) | Inquiry and engineering differ by the direction of fit of their predicates, not in kind: inquiry adds predicates its object already passes and engineering imposes predicates its object must be made to pass, so the one difference the record draws between inquiry and specification, that inquiry can revise what an answer could be, recurs inside engineering whenever building shows an imposed requirement cannot be met and it is rewritten to describe what can | Filed under the dialectic regime on 2026-11-22, answering the owner's "tell me about our current account of specification". | [CLAIM-949](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-949.md) | The record's account of specification is model-theoretic, a set of tests and the versions that pass them all, as an institution pairs sentences with the models that satisfy them; type theory is its proof-relevant counterpart, in which a specification is a type, a question a problem, a realization an inhabitant carried with the evidence that it passes, adding a descriptor a refinement the entry provably inhabits, which is why descriptors cannot conflict, and the direction of fit is bidirectional typing's split between inferring a type from a term and checking a term against a type given | Filed under the dialectic regime at the owner's "relate specification to type theory", 2026-11-22. | [CLAIM-975](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-975.md) | In liquid types, as in Freeman and Pfenning's refinement types, checking moves no program, and a refinement that fails to check does not show that the program fails it: inference returns Failure whenever no conjunction of the given qualifiers can be verified by a conservative check, so the failure may lie in the program, in the qualifier set or in the checker, and every remedy the paper names, adding a qualifier, inserting a run-time check or changing the program, lies outside the checker | Filed from the reading of Rondon, Kawaguchi and Jhala ([THEORY-2262](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-2262.md), [NOTE-2353](../../../record/notes.d/NOTE-2353.md)) for [LEAD-215](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-215.md), answering its question of what happens to a program whose refinement fails. | [CLAIM-1075](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1075.md) v2 | For an adaptive inquiry the achievement is not flow as a state but flow-regulation as an organizational capability: to enter, sustain, interrupt and recover fluent coordination without losing the history of what was learned, so that a coordination system should remove the interruptions that rediscover what was settled while keeping those that expose an unaddressed objection or an inadequate premise | A20 §6 and its closing proposition in the exchange "Explain First Contact RL" (ChatGPT, 2026-11-22).
